title: Prepare a new sub-account for a member
description: Fills in the new sub-account form for a member and stops at the review screen. Opening the account (Confirm) is left to a person.
goal: Sign on, look up member {{inputs.memberId}}, start opening a sub-account of type {{inputs.accountType}} with nickname {{inputs.nickname}} and initial deposit {{inputs.initialDeposit}}, continue to the review screen, and stop there. Do not confirm.

probes.why: an opening deposit below the minimum
